ideas.title: Cyberattacks on Water Systems: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the recent cyberattacks on water systems and the measures being taken to prevent future attacks.
questions: What are the potential consequences of a cyberattack on a water system?
What measures are being taken to prevent future attacks?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to highlight the importance of cybersecurity in protecting critical infrastructure. I will investigate the recent attacks and the measures being taken to prevent future incidents.
